info.title: CollectWise API
info.description: An API for managing debtors, tracking statuses, and automating debt collection processes

get.description: Returns all debtors from the system that the user has access to

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor to retrieve

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor to update

delete.description: Delete a debtor using their unique identifier

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor to delete

post.description: Creates multiple debtor records in bulk

requestBody.description: Array of debtor information to add

index.description: Index of the failed debtor in the input array

get.description: Retrieve the current status of a specific debtor

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor

get.description: Retrieve the current status of all debtors

totalCount.description: Total number of debtor statuses retrieved

patch.summary: Update debtor status to Paid Creditor Directly
patch.description: Update the status of a specific debtor to 'Paid Creditor Directly'

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor

message.example: Debtor status updated to 'Paid Creditor Directly' successfully

post.description: Sends an automated voicemail to the specified phone number

message.description: The voicemail message to be delivered

callbackNumber.description: Callback phone number in E.164 format

voiceGender.description: Gender of the voice to use for the voicemail

example.message: Hello, this is an important message regarding your account...

400.description: Invalid phone number format or missing required fields

get.description: Returns a list of active clean phone numbers that can be used as caller IDs for voicemail drops. Numbers are filtered by group (overseas or inhouse) and scoped to your organization.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The group of clean numbers to retrieve

example.message: group must be one of: overseas, inhouse

post.description: Initiates an RPC (Right Party Contact) call to verify debtor identity

toNumber.description: Phone number to call in E.164 format (e.g., +18768828822)

dob.description: Debtor's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Either dob or last4SSN must be provided

last4SSN.description: Last 4 digits of debtor's SSN. Either dob or last4SSN must be provided

voicemailMessage.description: Message to leave if the call goes to voicemail

callbackNumber.description: Phone number in E.164 format that missed calls will be routed to upon callbacks

agencyName.description: Optional name of the collection agency

agentName.description: Optional name of the agent making the call, defaults to Nancy

successNumber.description: Optional phone number in E.164 format to route the call to upon successful RPC

customMessage.description: Optional message to be played after introduction but before RPC verification

instantTransferToggle.description: When true, transfers the call to successNumber immediately after name verification, bypassing DOB/SSN verification

example.voicemailMessage: Hello, this is an important message regarding your account...
example.customMessage: This call is regarding an important financial matter that requires your immediate attention.

400.description: Invalid phone number format or missing required fields

get.description: Retrieve call recording with optional transcript and analysis data

parameters.name: callId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the call

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Recording format

parameters.name: include_transcript
parameters.description: Include call transcript

parameters.name: include_analysis
parameters.description: Include call analysis

404.description: Not Found - Call ID not found

patch.description: Pauses the active workflow for the specified debtor, suppressing outbound communications.

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor

404.description: Debtor not found or not enrolled

patch.description: Resumes the active workflow for the specified debtor, re-enabling outbound steps.

parameters.name: debtorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the debtor

404.description: Debtor not found or not enrolled

get.description: Provides workflow meta, totals, stage breakdown, window hours, SMS summary, and recent SMS for a workflow.

parameters.name: workflowId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the workflow

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Lookback window in hours. Defaults to 24; clamped to [1, 8760].

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Specific UTC day in YYYY-MM-DD format; when provided, supersedes the hours window.

post.summary: Per-debtor workflow status and recent SMS
post.description: Returns per-debtor status (paused, next stage/time), SMS counts, and recent SMS for provided debtorIds within a workflow.

404.description: Workflow or one or more debtors not found

get.description: Retrieves the call outcome for a specific TCN call ID. This endpoint is designed to support TCN's SIP integration where calls are routed to CollectWise AI agents.

parameters.name: tcn-cid
parameters.description: The TCN call identifier

400.description: Invalid or missing TCN CID parameter

404.description: Call outcome not found (call in progress or not available)

get.description: Returns a complete billing breakdown with usage counts and costs across all channels for a given date range.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of date range. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to 00:00:00 UTC) or a full ISO 8601 UTC timestamp like 2025-02-01T05:00:00Z

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of date range. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to 23:59:59 UTC) or a full ISO 8601 UTC timestamp like 2025-02-28T04:59:59Z

400.description: Invalid request — missing or invalid date parameters, or billing not configured

403.description: Invalid API key or billing access not enabled

get.description: Lists every SMS template available to your organization, including the placeholder variables each one expects. Call this first to discover the `templateId` and the variable names to pass to the send endpoint.

templates.message: {Consumer Name}, {Company Name} is a debt collector attempting to collect a debt. Visit {Website Payment} using your account# {Account Number} or call {Phone#}. Reply STOP to opt out.

403.description: Texting is not enabled for your organization.

example.error: Texting is not enabled for this organization

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. See the Retry-After response header.

get.description: Fetches a single template's body and its placeholder variables.

parameters.name: templateId
parameters.description: The template's identifier.

example.message: {Consumer Name}, {Company Name} is a debt collector attempting to collect a debt. Visit {Website Payment} using your account# {Account Number} or call {Phone#}. Reply STOP to opt out.

403.description: Texting is not enabled for your organization.

example.error: Texting is not enabled for this organization

404.description: No template with that id exists in your organization's account.

post.description: Returns how many SMS segments a message will use, matching the Twilio segment calculator. Provide either a raw `message`, or a `templateId` with `variables` (the template is rendered first, then counted). This endpoint does not send anything.

message.description: A raw message to measure. Provide this OR templateId.

templateId.description: A template to render and measure. Provide this OR message.

variables.description: Values substituted into the template's placeholders (when using templateId).

value.message: Hi Jane, your balance is $430.10. Reply STOP to opt out.

400.description: Body had neither `message` nor `templateId`, or `templateId` was not an integer.

post.description: Renders an SMS template with the supplied variables and sends it to one phone number. A 200 means the message was accepted and queued, not yet delivered — use the returned `messageId` with the status endpoint. Sandbox API keys are rejected.

templateId.description: The template to send. Must belong to your organization's account.

variables.description: Values substituted into the template's `{placeholder}` tokens. Use `{}` if the template has none. If any placeholder is left unresolved, the request fails with 400 rather than texting a literal `{token}`.

debtorId.description: Your reference for this recipient (e.g. your account or reference number). Forwarded as-is; replies and the message record are tracked against it.

messageId.description: Delivery-tracking ID. Use it with the status endpoint.

400.description: Invalid body: bad phone number, missing or non-integer `templateId`, missing `debtorId`, bad `variables`, or unresolved template placeholders.

example.error: Missing variables for placeholders: Consumer Name

403.description: Texting not enabled for your organization, the template is not in your account, or a sandbox key was used.

example.error: Template is not available for your account

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 sends/min per organization).

502.description: The SMS service rejected or failed the send.

get.description: Returns delivery status for a previously sent message. `messageId` is the value returned by the send endpoint. Delivery reports arrive asynchronously from the carrier, so poll after a short delay.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The messageId returned by the send endpoint.

404.description: No message with that id for your organization.

rvm.description: Ringless Voicemail — has two-part pricing (per-drop + per-hour duration)

duration_unit_cost_per_hour.description: Cost per hour of voicemail audio

param.description: The parameter that caused the error (if applicable)

error.message: start_date is required and must be YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

accountId.description: The account the template belongs to (your organization's configured account).

placeholders.description: Variable names you must supply in `variables` when sending.

encoding.description: Encoding the message is sent with. Any non-GSM-7 character (emoji, smart quotes, most CJK) forces the whole message to UCS-2.

characterCount.description: Number of characters in the message.

gsm7Length.description: Length in GSM-7 units (extended characters such as { } [ ] ~ \ | ^ € cost 2).

segmentCount.description: Number of SMS segments the message will use.

maxCharsPerSegment.description: Max characters per segment for the chosen encoding (160 GSM-7, 70 UCS-2).

status.description: Carrier status: Queued, Sent, Delivered, or Rejected / Failed / Undelivered on failure.

failureClassification.description: On failed messages: FATAL (do not retry), NON_FATAL (transient, retry may succeed), or null when the carrier reason is unrecognized.

retryRecommended.description: True when the failure is NON_FATAL and a retry may succeed.
